status: PRE-REGISTERED before any model performance was computed (data extraction and integrity checks only)
pooling: none; each bank evaluated and classified independently
units: IDR billion; standalone quarters reconstructed from YTD (Q1 = YTD; Qn = YTD_n - YTD_(n-1), same-document vintage)

targets.T1_primary: consolidated profit attributable to owners of the parent, standalone quarter (quarterly publication, CONSOLIDATED column)
targets.T2_secondary: consolidated net interest income, standalone quarter

scopes: bank-only (INDIVIDUAL) and consolidated values kept separate; bank-only is mapped to consolidated only through the explicit consolidation adjustment defined below
vintages: original (first-listed, non-revised) documents; BBCA quarters without an own publication (2019Q4, 2020Q1, 2020Q4, 2021Q1, 2021Q2) take the prior-period column of the next year's publication and are available for training only from that document's date
forecast_origin: verified publication date of the quarter's month-2 bank-only report (Feb/May/Aug/Nov). Primary: observations with unverified month-2 dates are EXCLUDED.

availability_rules.BBCA: YYYYMMDD filename prefix if 5-75 days after period end; else unverified
availability_rules.unverified_quarterly_docs: end of the month following quarter end (conservative)
availability_rules.sensitivity_conservative: origin = later of (verified date, end of month following month 2); unverified origins included at that conservative date; quarterly docs at the later of verified date and end of month following quarter end

information_set_at_origin: monthly bank-only reports and quarterly publications whose availability date <= origin; nothing published later; no revised figures

definitions.BO2: bank-only quarter-to-date for months 1-2 = YTD(m2) - YTD(previous quarter end, bank-only; 0 for Q1)
definitions.BOQ: bank-only standalone quarter from the quarterly publication INDIVIDUAL column
definitions.m3_hist: BOQ - BO2 for past quarters with both available
definitions.Adj: T - BOQ (consolidation adjustment: subsidiaries, eliminations, minorities) for past quarters

unconditional.U4_AR1: OLS T_t = a + b T_(t-1) on available history (min 8 obs), one-step forecast

information_matched.IM1_x1.5: BOQ_hat = 1.5 x BO2; T_hat = BOQ_hat + Adj(latest available quarter)
information_matched.IM2_hist_avg_m3: BOQ_hat = BO2 + mean(m3_hist over available quarters); + Adj(latest)
information_matched.IM4_seasonal_runrate: BOQ_hat = BO2 x (1 + m3_hist(q-4)/BO2(q-4)); T_hat = BOQ_hat x mean(T/BOQ over last 4 available quarters)

model.name: M1 component model (parsimonious; parameters are medians of past ratios, no optimisation, no ML)
model.T1: T_hat = BO2 + [NII_m3 + CORE_m3 - IMP_m3] x (1 - tax) + ADJ_hat
model.NII_m3: NII(month 2) x days(m3)/days(m2) x (1 + g), g = bank-only loan growth month 2 vs month 1, capped at +/-3%
model.CORE_m3: non-NII operating result before impairment (operating profit - NII + impairment) of month 3 = mean(months 1,2) x rho_core
model.IMP_m3: impairment expense of month 3 = mean(months 1,2) x rho_imp
model.rho: median of past (month-3 value / mean(months 1,2)) for the same quarter-of-year if >= 2 observations, else all past quarters; month-3 values = quarterly bank-only YTD minus month-2 YTD
model.ADJ_hat: mean of Adj over the last 4 available quarters
model.T2: NII_cons_hat = NII_BO2 + NII_m3 + mean(NII Adj over last 4 available quarters)
model.minimum_history: at least 4 past quarters with m3_hist and Adj available, else no forecast for any method at that origin

test_period: 2021Q1-2026Q3 quarters with a model forecast and all benchmark forecasts (common sample per bank)
metrics: relative MAE improvement vs each benchmark
OOS R2 vs U3 (1 - SSE/SSE_U3) and vs best IM
directional accuracy: sign(forecast - T(q-4)) == sign(actual - T(q-4))
90% CI of MAE ratio (moving-block bootstrap, block 4, 5000 reps, seed 20261125)
Diebold-Mariano (absolute loss, Newey-West lag floor(n^(1/3)), Harvey-Leybourne-Newbold small-sample correction, one-sided)
multiple_comparisons: Holm adjustment across the 4 information-matched comparisons; one model only
pass_rule_T1: n >= 16 AND MAE(M1) <= 0.85 x MAE(best IM by MAE) AND Holm-adjusted one-sided DM p <= 0.05 vs that best IM

classification.GO: pass_rule_T1 on the primary (verified-date) sample AND MAE improvement >= 15% vs best IM in the conservative-date sensitivity
classification.CONDITIONAL_GO: pass_rule_T1 fails, but (a) best IM beats best unconditional by >= 15% with DM p <= 0.05 (public monthly information is valuable even if M1 adds nothing), OR (b) M1 passes on T2 only, OR (c) M1 passes primary but not the sensitivity

attribution: information value = best IM vs best unconditional; model value = M1 vs best IM
cross_bank: report correlation of M1 errors between banks on common quarters; no pooling
change_policy: no changes after performance is observed; any later variant must be registered separately and evaluated prospectively
